svg.title: States a tool-call approval moves through
svg.desc: When a manifest's approval rule matches a tool call, the wrapper looks for an existing approved grant for the same call signature, a hash of its arguments, before creating anything; a grant marked one_shot is searched with unconsumed_only, so it authorises exactly one call. With no grant, create_pending writes a pending row, or reuses a live pending row for the same signature, and the run waits on it. A row is only ever pending, approved or denied. A person approves, optionally with edited arguments that the tool then runs with, or denies. Nobody answering is also a denial: when the deadline passes, the harness closes the row as denied with the note timeout, or interrupted when the run was cut short, and the model is told the call was refused. An approved grant is reused by identical calls until its expires_at, after which it stops matching and the next identical call asks again. Spending a one_shot grant is a single conditional UPDATE, so two concurrent identical calls cannot both spend it.
